result.topic_en: Variation of the elastic energy integral of an isotropic body (with Lamé constants λ, μ), deriving the equilibrium equations and expressing strain quantities through potential-like functions α, β, γ and the dilatation p.
result.transcription:
$\int dx\,dy\,dz \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}\right)^2+\mu\left[\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}-\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial z}-\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}\right)^2\right] = \min$ II
$u\;(\lambda+2\mu)\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}\right)m+\mu\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)n+\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}-\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}\right)p =$
$N_1\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\mu(\Gamma_3^2+\Gamma_1^2+\Gamma_2^2)$
$\lambda\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}\right)^2+2\mu\left(\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}\right)^2\right)+\mu\left(\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial z}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}\right)^2+\cdots\right)$
$p \qquad q_1 \qquad r_1$
$u\left(\lambda\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}+2\mu\frac{\partial q_1}{\partial x}+\mu\frac{\partial r_3}{\partial y}+\mu\frac{\partial r_2}{\partial z}\right)$ $\quad r_1=\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial y\partial z}$
$v\left(\lambda\frac{\partial p}{\partial y}+2\mu\frac{\partial q_2}{\partial y}+\mu\left(\frac{\partial r_1}{\partial z}+\frac{\partial r_3}{\partial x}\right)\right)$ $\quad r_2=\frac{\partial^2\beta}{\partial z\partial x}$
$w\left(\lambda\frac{\partial p}{\partial z}+2\mu\frac{\partial q_3}{\partial z}+\mu\left(\frac{\partial r_2}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial r_1}{\partial y}\right)\right)$ $\quad r_3=\frac{\partial^2\gamma}{\partial x\partial y}$
[-$r_3=\frac{\partial\alpha_1}{\partial z}$-] [-$r_2=-\frac{\partial\alpha_1}{\partial y}$-]
$2q_1=-\frac{\partial^2\gamma}{\partial y^2}-\frac{\partial^2\beta}{\partial z^2}-\frac{\lambda}{\mu}p$
$2q_2=-\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial z^2}-\frac{\partial^2\gamma}{\partial x^2}-\frac{\lambda}{\mu}p$
$2q_3=-\frac{\partial^2\beta}{\partial x^2}[?]-\frac{\partial^2\alpha}{\partial y^2}-\frac{\lambda}{\mu}p$
$\alpha$ ausgedrückt [?] in $-\int v\,dy-\int w\,dz$
$\beta$ ausgedrückt [?] in $-\int w\,dz-\int u\,dx$
$\gamma$ ausgedrückt [?] in $-\int u\,dx-\int v\,dy$
$p$ ausgedrückt [?] in $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}$
